title: Zauner's Conjecture
exact_target: Does every finite-dimensional complex Hilbert space admit a symmetric informationally complete quantum measurement?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1106 (ALG-006). CC BY 4.0.

Marcus Appleby, Steven T. Flammia and Gene S. Kopp, \emph{A Constructive Approach to Zauner’s Conjecture via the Stark Conjectures}, arXiv:2501.03970v2 (2025), §1, Definitions 1.1--1.2 and Conjecture 1.3. The separate symmetry conjectures and conditional construction are distinguished from universal SIC existence.
